name: Plantar fasciitis stretch
pitch: A personalized morning and evening stretching routine for plantar fasciitis.
instructions: Start by searching the web for reliable plantar fasciitis stretching guides. Look for morning and evening protocols that are commonly recommended. When nothing useful is found, say so and ask the person if they have a preferred source or any health advice they follow. Read the found pages and note the key stretches, how long to hold each, and how many repeats. If the pages contradict each other, pick the most gentle version and note the source. Create a text page with the routine: a morning section and an evening section. List each stretch, the hold time, and the repeat count. Use plain language and short sentences. When the page is ready, ask the person if they want to turn it into a routine. If they say yes, use routine_create to schedule the morning and evening stretches at times they choose. If they say no, just save the page for them to read later. When nothing is found during the search, say plainly that no stretching guides were found and ask if they want to try a different topic. Do not invent stretches or give medical advice. Tell the person plainly what could not be checked.
starters: show me my plantar fasciitis stretches

examples.does: search the web for plantar fasciitis stretches and note the results

skills.name: build-the-stretch-page
skills.description: Make a page with morning and evening stretch protocols.
skills.body: 1. Use make_page to create a new page titled 'Plantar fasciitis stretch routine'. 2. Write a short intro saying this is for plantar fasciitis and not medical advice. 3. Add a morning protocol section. List 3 to 5 stretches. For each, name the stretch, say how many repeats, and how long to hold. 4. Add an evening protocol section with the same format. 5. Keep sentences under 20 words. 6. Save the page and show it to the person.

skills.name: schedule-the-routine
skills.description: Add the stretches to the assistant's routine system.
skills.body: 1. Ask the person what time they want the morning stretch and what time for the evening stretch. 2. Use routine_create to add a morning task with the stretch list. 3. Use routine_create to add an evening task with the stretch list. 4. If the person does not give times, ask them to choose. 5. Tell the person the routines are set and show the stretch page again.

readme:
Plantar fasciitis stretch routine
A personal morning and evening stretching plan for plantar fasciitis.
Uses web search to find stretches, makes a page, and can schedule routines.
Will not give medical advice or invent stretches.
